ikarus.title: Lower 1 · Mon
ikarus.notes: Written from the Logbook program. Change the program there; the next run overwrites edits made here.

body.notes: 3 × 6-10 — RIR 2-3 — add reps at the same weight before adding weight
3 × 8-12 — feet low, shoulder-width, toes out — stop the descent where the right heel starts to lift
3 × 8-12 — shins vertical at the top, knees at 90° — quads burning: feet further out; hamstrings cramping: feet closer. Push through the heels, right forefoot light
3 × 30-45 s — in place of carries — same belt kg on all three sets; add weight once every set passes 45 s
3 × 10-15 — DB at chest, round-back
